programme.desc: 'S2/E2'. Die Commitee en Choristers is almal lede van die Stellenbosse Universiteitskoor wie se musiekkennis behoorlik getoets word. Wie gaan die rande laat inrol?

programme.title: Slim Vang Sy Baas: Musiek
programme.desc: 'S2/E3'. Die Suikerbessies en Schayes takel mekaar in agt rondes van musiekvasvrae en ander nuwe speletjies. Wie staan die kans om as die wenners van die episode gekroon te word?

programme.title: Afrikaans Is 100 Jaar Groot
programme.desc: Kom beleef Afrikaans is 100 Jaar Groot vanuit die gemak van jou rusbank.

programme.title: Herman Se Tafel
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Herman inspireer jou dié feestyd met maklike geregte en pragtige dekorplanne. Hierdie week berei hy 'n goue ervaring voor en maak 'n fênsie garnaalvoorgereg, 'n varkfeesmaal en 'n somer-trifle.

programme.title: Herman Se Tafel
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Herman vier die feesseisoen soos nog nooit tevore nie. Hierdie week gaan hy bont met kleur en geur. Hy gooi 'n ertjie-en-fetaslaai bymekaar, berei 'n lamsboud voor en maak cassata-roomys.

programme.title: Herman Se Tafel
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Herman deel feestydkos en dekor-inspirasie uit sy nuwe boek. Hierdie week maak hy tong met mosterdsous, moskonfyt-lamsblad met swart aartappels, en 'n maklike en vinnige nagereg.

programme.title: Bertus Vier Fees
programme.desc: Die bekende Bertus Basson wys ons hoe jy 'n sjefferige feesmaal in pas met vanjaar se kosmodes vir jou geliefdes kan voorsit.

programme.title: Herman Se Fees
programme.desc: In dié spesiale feesbonanza nooi die SARIE-kosredakteur, Herman Lensing, ons sy kombuis binne en deel hy oulike idees vir 'n feestyd-okkasie waaroor jou gaste vir weke sal skinder.

programme.title: Bertus Se Feestafel
programme.desc: In dié spesiale feesbonanza nooi Bertus Basson en sy vrou, Mareli, ons hul kombuis binne en wys hulle hoe jy op 'n eg Suid-Afrikaanse én byderwetse manier in Desember kan feesvier.

programme.desc: 'S4/E1'. Aanbieder Francois Jacobs lei vier amateur-speurders om fiktiewe moorde in Franschhoek op te los. Daar is 'n groot kontantprys op die spel!

programme.title: Wie Was Dit?
programme.desc: 'S4/E2'. Speurders Juanita en Rodney begin met 'n punt voorsprong en die volgende moord in die wynlande moet opgelos word.

programme.title: Wie Was Dit?
programme.desc: 'S4/E3'. Die hoofsanger van 'n rockgroep is vermoor en die speurders span saam om die saak op te los. Wie gaan vennootskappe sluit en wie gaan leidrade koop?

programme.title: Wie Was Dit?
programme.desc: 'S4/E4'. Daar is 'n moord gepleeg op 'n gholflandgoed buite Franschhoek. Die speurders word ingeroep om ondersoek in te stel, Tussen 'n liefdesdriehoek, bedrog en mag moet hulle uitvind wie was dit?

programme.title: Wie Was Dit?
programme.desc: 'S4/E5'. n Mynbaas is onder geheimsinnige omstandighede vermoor. Die speurders is onder geweldige druk. Wie hou uiteindelik die goue vergrootglas vas en neem die boerpot huistoe?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E2'. Janine, Annette en Hendri kry in hierdie uitdunronde die geleentheid om groot geldpotte op te bou. Maar hulle sal eers verby mekaar moet kom. Wie gaan as wenner uit die stryd tree?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E3'. Ridley, Pieter en Brandon is al te bewus dat hulle nie als hoef te weet nie, maar net seker moet maak dat hulle die regte vrae moet uitdeel. Hoe belangrik gaan die blitsrondes in hierdie episode wees?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E4'. Letitia, Johan en Cobus is vasbeslote om stewige geldpotte op te bou in hierdie episode. Hoe gou gaan hulle mekaar se swakpunte leer ken om dit oor drie rondes teen mekaar te gebruik?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. Rudie, Annie en Christiaan se mikpunt gaan wees om so ver moontlik in die kompetisie te vorder. Maar wie van hulle gaan nie net die meeste vrae korrek antwoord nie?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E6'. Chanré, Christo en Mari meet kragte teen mekaar. Ons het al telkemale gesien dat 'n vinnige en goeie begin nie noodwendig tot 'n oorwinning lei nie. Die deelnemers gaan op net die regte tyd moet probeer skitter.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E7'. Hoe verder hulle vorder, hoe meer geld kan gemaak word. Dit is wat in Marcel, Shaun en Johan se gedagte sal wees wanneer hulle mekaar in hierdie episode aanvat. Goeie mensekennis sal die sleutel tot oorwinning wees.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E8'. Watter verskil gaan lewenservaring maak in Ivan, Wynand en Eddie se soeke na 'n oorwinning: Gaan hulle deur mekaar se aanvalsplan kan sien om sodoende die beste strategie toe te pas?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E9'. Landolph, Anne-Marie en Christo pak mekaar in hierdie uitdunrondte. Hulle het die geleentheid om potte vol geld te maak. Hoe deurslaggewend gaan die blitsrondtes vir elke speler se strategie wees?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E10'. Daan, Arthur en Danielle meet kragte in hierdie uitdunrondte van Wie weet wat? Die skerpste potlood in die blikkie gaan nie noodwendig seëvier nie. Alles hang af van die strategie op die dag.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E12'. In dié uitdunrondte kom Réze, Amanda en Jacobie teen mekaar te staan. Wie van die drie vroue sal eerste hul strategie in werking kan stel en hoe deurslaggewend gaan dit wees?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E13'. Charles, Jacob en Carel het almal een doel voor oë en dit is om te wen en deur te dring na die volgende rondte. Maar voor hulle dit kan doen, moet hulle eers verby mekaar kom.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E14'. Op Wie weet wat baat 'n goeie begin jou niks as jy dit nie kan deurvoer en as oorwinnaar uit die stryd tree nie. Wie van Belia, Annas en Jeani gaan op die regte oomblikke hul staal wys?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E15'. Deon, Carina en Goolam gaan meer as net die antwoorde op die vrae moet ken, hulle sal ook mekaar se swakplekke moet uitvind. Die een wat dit die gouste kan doen, sal groot voordeel daaruit trek.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E16'. Gaan Roscoe, 'n bokspromotor, die houe kan vat wat Nicole en Walter na sy kant toe gooi, of is 'n uitklophou by die geldpotte sy voorland? Vind uit wanneer hierdie drie mekaar aanvat in dié uitdunrondte.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E17'. Dit is Gert, Anieka en Rosita se beurt om mekaar te probeer uitoorlê. Gaan hulle Abdu se woorde dat 'n goeie strategie nodig is om groot geld te maak, ter harte neem en uitvoer?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E18'. Juanita, Johan en Avis gaan mekaar in hierdie uitdunrondte uit die pad wil skouer om tot die volgende rondte deur te dring.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E19'. Daniël, Ridley en Hendri keer terug vir hul tweede verskyning op Wie weet wat. Hulle het nie in hul vorige verskyning gewen nie, maar kry nou die geleentheid om op te maak daarvoor.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E20'. Brandon, Janine en Christiaan keer terug om hierdie keer 'n beter vertoning te lewer. Hulle kry ook die geleentheid om beter te doen wat die geldpotte betref. Wie se strategie gaan die beste werk?

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S2/E22'. Rudie, Mari en Cobus se doel is om baie geld in hul geldpotte te stop. Hulle sal egter eers mekaar se strategieë moet uitoorlê om dit te vermag. Wie gaan dit die beste doen?

programme.title: Wie Was Dit?

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Ronaldinho
programme.desc: Ronaldinho. Ronaldinho's finest Clásico came on the 19th of November of 2005. Just one point separated both teams in the table, but the Brazilian proved that the gulf on the pitch was much greater.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Andrés Iniesta
programme.desc: Andrés Iniesta. Andrés Iniesta Luján. A normal person that was capable of the extraordinary. A glorious career which was also built, in part, on magical performances in ElClásico.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: James Rodríguez
programme.desc: James Rodríguez. James Rodríguez forced his way into Real Madrid's history books by virtue of his footballing IQ, his magic on the ball and his ability to impress a hugely demanding fanbase.

programme.title: El Clasico Moments: BAR v RMA 18/19
programme.desc: 'El Clasico Moments - Barcelona vs Real Madrid 2018/19'. A celebration of football's fiercest rivalry, El Clásico. From stunning goals to unforgettable drama, we revisit the clashes that defined generations and shaped legends.

programme.title: El Clasico Moments: BAR v RMA 21/22
programme.desc: 'El Clasico Moments - Barcelona vs Real Madrid 2021/22'. A celebration of football's fiercest rivalry, El Clásico. From stunning goals to unforgettable drama, we revisit the clashes that defined generations and shaped legends.

programme.title: El Clasico Moments: BAR v RMA 08/09
programme.desc: 'El Clasico Moments - Barcelona vs Real Madrid 2008/09'. A celebration of football's fiercest rivalry, El Clásico. From stunning goals to unforgettable drama, we revisit the clashes that defined generations and shaped legends.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Ousmane Dembélé
programme.desc: Ousmane Dembélé. During his spell at Barcelona, Ousmane Dembele took part in six LaLiga Clásicos - nine in total - with a record of five wins and four defeats. But two of these fixtures will probably stand out above the rest.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Álvaro Arbeloa
programme.desc: Álvaro Arbeloa. Álvaro Arbeloa played a key role in Clásicos, where he was handed the unenviable task of defending the likes of Leo Messi, Neymar Jr, Alexis Sánchez or David Villa down his flank.

programme.title: El Clasico Legends: Gareth Bale
programme.desc: Gareth Bale. Gareth Bale played in LaLiga 11 Clásicos and 15 in total. And despite his numbers against Barcelona not being spectacular, he did score a memorable goal in the 2014 Copa del Rey final.

programme.title: LaLiga HL 21/22: Barcelona v R Madrid
programme.desc: 'LaLiga Santander Highlights - Matchday 10: Barcelona vs Real Madrid'. A tense El Clásico packed with chances and bold play saw Real Madrid edge a determined Barcelona, showcasing intensity and high stakes that define this iconic fixture.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Australian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Louis Vuitton Australian Grand Prix'. The Australian GP was the chaotic season opener, won by McLaren's Lando Norris from pole position after a dramatic race marked by mixed weather and multiple safety cars

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Chinese GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Chinese Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri won the Chinese main race from pole position, leading a McLaren one-two finish ahead of teammate Lando Norris.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Japan GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Lenovo Japanese Grand Prix'. The Japanese GP was won by Max Verstappen, who fended off a race-long challenge from the two McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Bahrain GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Bahrain Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri of McLaren converted his pole position to a victory, ahead of George Russell of Mercedes and Piastri's teammate Lando Norris.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Saudi Arabia GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - STC Saudi Arabian Grand Prix'. Oscar Piastri won the 2025 Saudi Arabian GP, taking the WDC lead for McLaren. Verstappen took P2 despite a 5s penalty, with Leclerc P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Miami GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Crypto.com Miami Grand Prix'. Piastri storms to victory at the 2025 Miami GP, leading a McLaren 1-2 with Norris. Russell takes third as Verstappen slips to fourth after losing the lead on lap 14.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Emilia-Romagna GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - AWS Gran Premio Del Made in Italy E Dell'Emilia-Romagna'. Verstappen triumphs at Imola, winning the Emilia-Romagna GP ahead of Norris and Piastri.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Monaco GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Grand Prix De Monaco'. Norris won from pole, holding off Leclerc. Piastri P3. Verstappen P4 after a late tire gamble failed. Norris's win cut the title lead to 3 points in a strategic race.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Spanish GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Aramco Gran Premio De Espana'. Oscar Piastri controlled the race from pole position, leading a strong showing by McLaren. Lando Norris finished just a few seconds behind.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Canada GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Pirelli Grand Prix Du Canada'. Russell claims pole-to-flag win in Montreal, with Verstappen second and rookie Antonelli third. Russell nabbed fastest lap, McLaren's Norris and Piastri collide late.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Austrian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises Austrian Grand Prix'. Norris won at the Red Bull Ring. Piastri P2 ensured McLaren dominance on Red Bull's turf with Leclerc finishing P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: British GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways British Grand Prix'. Norris won a wet-dry home GP. Piastri P2, with Hulkenberg a shock P3 for Sauber.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Belgian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Belgian Grand Prix'. Piastri won at Spa. Norris P2, Leclerc P3. McLaren extended their Constructors' lead significantly over Red Bull.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Hungarian GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Lenovo Hungarian Grand Prix'. Lando Norris wins for McLaren, narrowly beating his teammate Oscar Piastri in a thrilling finish, marking McLaren's 200th F1 win.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Netherlands GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Dutch Grand Prix'. Piastri spoiled Verstappen's home party with a win. Verstappen P2, Hadjar a shock P3 for RB.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Italy GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Pirelli Gran Premio D'Italia'. Verstappen won at Monza. Norris P2, Piastri P3. Ferrari missed the home podium as Leclerc finished P4.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Azerbaijan GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways Azerbaijan Grand Prix'. Verstappen mastered the Baku streets to win from pole. Russell P2, while Carlos Sainz took a maiden Williams podium in P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Singapore GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix'. George Russell converted pole into a brilliant win. Verstappen took P2 after holding off a fierce charge from Norris (P3).

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: United States GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix'. Verstappen dominated the weekend, winning both the Sprint and the Grand Prix. Norris beat Leclerc to P2 after a thrilling late-race duel.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Mexico GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Gran Premio De La Ciudad De Mexico'. Norris won from pole, Leclerc took P2, while Verstappen fought from P5 to P3. Rookie Ollie Bearman secured a career-best P4 for Haas.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Sao Paulo GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - MSC Cruises Grande Premio De Sao Paulo'. Norris mastered the rain at Interlagos to win both the Sprint and Grand Prix. Kimi Antonelli took a sensational P2 for Mercedes, with Verstappen P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Las Vegas GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix'. Verstappen won a cold, chaotic night race. Russell and Antonelli followed for a Mercedes 2-3. Both McLarens were disqualified for technical infringements.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Qatar GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Qatar Airways Qatar Grand Prix'. Verstappen won again after a McLaren strategy blunder. Piastri took P2 and Carlos Sainz scored a podium for Williams in P3.

programme.title: WhatAYear F1HL: '25: Abu Dhabi GP
programme.desc: 'Formula One Blitz Highlights - Etihad Airways Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'. Verstappen won the race, but Norris's P3 was enough to secure the World Championship by just 2 points.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Prologue
programme.desc: Prologue. The first contests on this year's edition of the Dakar took place at the gateway to the city of Bisha, on a terrain with a sequence of sandy tracks.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 1
programme.desc: Stage 1. Travelling south from Bisha, the air gets thinner and thinner as the road approaches 1,300 metres. The drop in oxygen levels is barely noticeable, but the landscape is no longer the same.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 2A
programme.desc: Stage 2A. The return journey to Bisha to complete the 48 HR Chrono expedition to the northeast of the city required passing through a 90-kilometre portion of grey dunes.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 2B
programme.desc: Stage 2B. The return journey to Bisha to complete the 48 HR Chrono expedition to the northeast of the city required passing through a 90-kilometre portion of grey dunes.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 3
programme.desc: Stage 3. The riders, drivers and crews dropped down by about 500 metres in altitude and especially had to tackle a beginning to the special that was very rocky, before picking up speed on sandy plateaus for approximately 200 kilometres.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 4
programme.desc: Stage 4. Prior to camping out in Berber tents, the competitors weaved their way around canyons, surged up rocky plateaus and turned on the afterburners on flat sandy expanses.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 5
programme.desc: Stage 5. The navigation was tricky on the last part of the special, where taking care of tyres was especially important on the terrain made up of large gravel.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Rest Day
programme.desc: Rest Day. 2025 will be the 47th edition of the Dakar Rally, organized by Amaury Sport Organisation (ASO), and the 6th time Saudi Arabia has hosted the event.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 6
programme.desc: Stage 6. Clarity of mind was essential to finding the way out of this maze of dunes ranging from white to saffron yellow depending on the angle of the light or the composition of the sand.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 7
programme.desc: Stage 7. The stage dazzled with views of Riyadh Province after rolling out of Al Duwadimi for a wide loop to the south-west of the city, stretching for a shade over 410 km.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 8
programme.desc: Stage 8. The day's special took place to the south of the capital, on split routes for the FIM and FIA vehicles, but both over distances of more than 480 kilometres.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 9
programme.desc: Stage 9. Over a distance of 357 kilometres and at a high pace requiring speedy roadbook reading, the main pitfalls to be concerned about was in regards to navigation.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 10
programme.desc: Stage 10. The field rolled out of Haradh to tackle a road section of more than 500 kilometres on route to the shores of the Arabian Gulf.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 11
programme.desc: Stage 11. There was a delay to the start of the stage which incited the bikers to request that the stage be shortened to 152km instead of the original 308km.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 12
programme.desc: Stage 12. The 47th edition of the Dakar and the 6th in Saudi Arabia was completed in Shubaytah by 175 vehicles - 77 bikes, 40 Ultimate cars, 1 Stock car, 21 Challengers, 23 SSVs and 13 trucks.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Event
programme.desc: Event. 2025 will be the 47th edition of the Dakar Rally, organized by Amaury Sport Organisation (ASO), and the 6th time Saudi Arabia has hosted the event.
